extension.description: Temporarily close sub directories (e.g. git worktrees) like Eclipse Close Project: they stay grayed in the Explorer and are excluded from search, Quick Open and Java symbols
config.excludeFromJava: Also exclude closed directories from Java project import (java.import.exclusions) so Go to Symbol (Ctrl+T) skips them.
config.closeStyle: How closed directories appear in the Explorer. Both styles exclude them from Find in Files and Quick Open.
config.closeStyle.dim: Keep them in the Explorer, grayed out (search.exclude). Like Eclipse Close Project.
config.closeStyle.hide: Hide them from the Explorer too (files.exclude).
